title: Pricing Determination: The Correction Percentage on Auto Loans Late Charges
content:
The correction percentage applied to the acting base on a loan of the Auto Loans line is determined from two records together: what the borrower has spent on their Personal Credit Cards card over the last twelve months, and how many scheduled installments have been credited to the loan over the same twelve months.

| Card purchases posted over the last twelve months | Scheduled installments credited to the loan in the last twelve months | Correction percentage |
|---|---|---|
| At least 6000.00 USD | At least 10 | 3.0 percent |
| At least 2500.00 USD, while either the purchases fall short of 6000.00 USD or the installments fall short of 10 | At least 6, while either the purchases fall short of 6000.00 USD or the installments fall short of 10 | 4.0 percent |
| Every other borrower | Every other borrower | 5.0 percent |

## The determination in words

The correction percentage is 3.0 percent where the borrower's card purchases over the last twelve months total at least 6000.00 USD and at least 10 scheduled installments have been credited to the loan in the last twelve months.

It is 4.0 percent where those purchases total at least 2500.00 USD and at least 6 scheduled installments have been credited to the loan in the last twelve months, while either those purchases fall short of 6000.00 USD or those installments fall short of 10.

It is 5.0 percent for every other borrower.

## Where the two readings come from

The purchase total is read from the purchases posted to the borrower's card account in the Personal Credit Cards line over the last twelve months. The installment count is read from the scheduled payments credited to the auto loan over the last twelve months.

## Readings that sit just inside and just outside a row

A borrower with 6000.00 USD of card purchases and 9 installments credited does not meet the first row, because both readings of that row must hold. They meet the second row, since 6000.00 is at least 2500.00, 9 is at least 6, and the installments fall short of 10.

A borrower with 2499.99 USD of card purchases meets neither of the first two rows, whatever their installment count, and takes 5.0 percent.

A borrower with 12000.00 USD of card purchases and 10 installments credited meets the first row exactly at the installment boundary and takes 3.0 percent.
